formal_statement: ∃ (n : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (h p q : ℕ) (gp gq : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.IsMinimalCircuit n C ∧ n ≤ h ∧ h < n + C.size ∧ h ≠ C.output ∧ (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (C.wires (List.ofFn x)).getD h false = false → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun n C x = true) ∧ p ≠ q ∧ h < n + p ∧ h < n + q ∧ C.gates[p]? = some gp ∧ C.gates[q]? = some gq ∧ gp.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ gq.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ h ∈ gp.inputs ∧ h ∈ gq.inputs ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ) (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), C.gates[j]? = some g → h < n + j → h ∈ (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.casesOn (motive := fun _ => List ℕ) g.op g.inputs g.inputs (g.inputs.take 1) (fun _ => g.inputs) g.inputs) → j = p ∨ j = q)
plain_statement: Is there a minimal circuit C on n inputs (AND, OR, NOT gates of fan-in at most two, no circuit of that kind with fewer gates computes its function) and a gate wire h, not the output, such that C outputs true on every input where h is false, two distinct later gates are AND gates listing h, and every later gate reading h (a NOT gate reads only its first wire) is one of those two? No witness is known; a witness or the negation is wanted. Conjecture either way.
title: Search: a minimal circuit with a non-output gate h read by exactly two later gates, both ANDs, and the function true wherever h is false
